title: Backend Development
text: Building robust, scalable server-side systems with Java, C#, .NET, and Spring Boot. Database design, RESTful APIs, and enterprise-grade architecture.
text_en: Building robust, scalable server-side systems with Java, C#, .NET, and Spring Boot. Database design, RESTful APIs, and enterprise-grade architecture.
text_jp: Java、C#、.NET、Spring Bootによる堅牢でスケーラブルなサーバーサイドシステムの構築。データベース設計、RESTful API、エンタープライズグレードのアーキテクチャ。

title: Frontend & Web Apps
title_jp: フロントエンド＆Webアプリ
text: Creating responsive, interactive web experiences with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. From pixel-perfect UIs to complex single-page applications.
text_en: Creating responsive, interactive web experiences with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. From pixel-perfect UIs to complex single-page applications.
text_jp: React、Next.js、Tailwind CSSによるレスポンシブでインタラクティブなWeb体験の構築。ピクセルパーフェクトなUIから複雑なSPAまで。

title: Cloud & DevOps
text: AWS-certified infrastructure design and deployment. CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker, and automated cloud operations for production workloads.
text_en: AWS-certified infrastructure design and deployment. CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker, and automated cloud operations for production workloads.
text_jp: AWS認定のインフラ設計とデプロイメント。CI/CDパイプライン、Dockerによるコンテナ化、本番ワークロードのためのクラウド自動運用。
